data.summary: Results-driven ServiceNow Developer with 5+ years of experience in designing, developing, and implementing enterprise solutions across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, CMDB and GRC/IRM modules. Skilled in workflow automation, platform customization, REST API integrations, and enterprise application development, with a strong focus on delivering scalable, secure, and efficient solutions. Committed to enhancing service delivery, optimizing business processes, improving user experience, and driving operational excellence while contributing to organizational growth and digital transformation initiatives.

soft_skills: Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
all_skills: Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills

responsibilities: Developed and enhanced ServiceNow GRC/IRM solutions, including Policy and Compliance Management, Risk Management, Control Management, Issue Management, Risk Assessments, and Audit Management, to support enterprise governance and regulatory compliance initiatives.

Configured risk statements, risk assessment methodologies, risk scoring models, risk indicators (KRIs), control objectives, control tests, and issue remediation workflows to improve enterprise risk visibility and compliance monitoring.

Designed and customized policy lifecycle workflows, policy attestations, compliance tasks, and automated approval processes to streamline governance activities and ensure adherence to organizational standards.
Implemented automated risk assessment questionnaires, risk calculation logic, and approval workflows using Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, and UI Policies.

Customized GRC/IRM workspaces, dashboards, reports, and Performance Analytics to provide real-time visibility into organizational risks, compliance status, control effectiveness, and remediation progress.

Developed secure platform functionality using Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Actions, Script Includes, Scheduled Jobs, Background Scripts, and Glide API, following ServiceNow best practices and upgrade-safe development standards.
Configured users, groups, roles, and Access Control Lists (ACLs) to enforce role- based security and ensure appropriate access to sensitive governance and compliance data.

Integrated ServiceNow GRC/IRM with external applications using REST APIs, Scripted REST APIs, JSON and XML payloads, OAuth 2.0, and Basic Authentication, enabling seamless exchange of compliance and risk-related information.
Implemented and enhanced HRSD Risk and Compliance processes by automating HR case evaluations, employee risk assessments, and governance workflows to improve regulatory compliance.
Built advanced Service Catalog Items and Record Producers with dynamic variables, approvals, SLAs, and automated fulfillment processes to support governance and operational requests.
Customized Agent Workspace and CSM Workspace components to improve agent productivity through configurable layouts, workspaces, and guided processes.
Managed data migration activities using Import Sets, Transform Maps, Data Sources, Scheduled Imports, Update Sets, and Scoped Applications, ensuring reliable deployments across multiple environments.
Contributed to CMDB health improvements through CI data quality validation, relationship mapping, Discovery support, and dependency management to enhance operational visibility.
Enhanced user experience by customizing Service Portal, developing reusable widgets, and implementing intuitive self-service interfaces for governance and compliance processes.
Performed root cause analysis, debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning to resolve production issues, improve platform stability, and ensure high-quality, upgrade- safe implementations.

Collaborated with business stakeholders, compliance teams, risk managers, and cross- functional development teams to gather requirements, design scalable solutions, and deliver enterprise applications aligned with ITIL and organizational governance standards.
Developed and customized ServiceNow ITSM modules, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management, and Service Catalog, to automate business processes and improve service delivery.

Implemented business requirements using Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, Data Policies, Scheduled Jobs, and Background Scripts, ensuring scalable and upgrade-safe solutions.
Designed and developed Service Catalog Items, Record Producers, Order Guides, Variable Sets, catalog client scripts, and approval workflows to streamline request fulfillment.
Customized forms, views, related lists, reference qualifiers, and client-side components to enhance usability and improve the overall user experience.
Developed automation using Flow Designer, including flows, subflows, approvals, notifications, and event-driven actions to eliminate manual processes and improve operational efficiency.
Created reusable server-side logic and custom scripts to automate assignment, SLA management, notifications, task creation, and business process orchestration.
Integrated ServiceNow with external applications using REST APIs, Scripted REST APIs, JSON and XML payload processing, and OAuth/Basic Authentication for secure data exchange.
Developed and customized Service Portal components, including widgets, client scripts, catalog pages, and UI enhancements to improve the self-service experience.
Built interactive reports, dashboards, and Performance Analytics indicators to provide insights into incident trends, SLA compliance, service performance, and operational KPIs.
Developed data import solutions using Import Sets, Transform Maps, Data Sources, and Scheduled Imports to automate data migration while maintaining data integrity.
Contributed to CMDB enhancements by developing scripts for CI updates, relationship management, and data validation to improve configuration data quality.
Implemented role-based security using Access Control Lists (ACLs), user criteria, and role configurations to protect sensitive business data and enforce organizational security policies.

Participated in application deployments using Update Sets, Scoped Applications, and version-controlled development practices, ensuring smooth migration across development, testing, and production environments.

Performed troubleshooting, debugging, and root cause analysis using System Logs, Background Scripts, JavaScript Debugger, and Script Tracer, resolving production issues and improving platform performance.

Collaborated with business analysts, solution architects, QA teams, and stakeholders to gather requirements, develop technical solutions, perform unit testing, and deliver high- quality enhancements aligned with ITIL best practices and ServiceNow development standards.

education.institution: HMS institute of Technology, VTU University, Tumkur

projects.name: Project #3
projects.description: Delivered a comprehensive ServiceNow implementation integrating HR Service Delivery (HRSD), ITSM, and Customer Service Management (CSM) for a global enterprise client, streamlining employee lifecycle processes and customer support operations.
